title: REQ · Send is disabled and submit is blocked when remaining quota is 0
summary: Send button disabled and handleSubmit returns early at zero quota
description: Context: the Send button is always enabled and handleSubmit only checks blank and over-limit. Desired behavior: at remaining 0 the button is disabled and handleSubmit returns before calling submitContribution. Expected result: no backend submit at zero quota. Why: prevents futile requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given remaining is 0, when the sheet renders, then the Send button has the disabled attribute
Given remaining is 0 and text is typed, when the form is submitted, then submitContribution is not called
Given remaining is above 0 and valid text, when the form is submitted, then submitContribution is called once
technical_constraints: Guard must precede the blank check side effects and any setEntries call
definition_of_done: Send disabled and submit blocked at 0; unchanged above 0
